policy.visible_action_rule: Every visible enabled action must have a working handler, working route, registered helper command, or an explicit disabled/coming-soon reason.
policy.external_write_rule: External sends, publishes, charges, syncs, DNS writes, uploads, credential copies, and access grants require explicit approval and audit evidence.

actions.label: BNA Helper
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the scoped Operations helper drawer.

test.expected_result: Helper context returns scoped tools and no duplicate public helper widget.

actions.label: Save login for child
actions.expected_behavior: Parent can set/reset only their own child's student username/password and sees the child name.

test.expected_result: Parent-scoped endpoint rejects cross-household student IDs.

actions.label: Create automation with helper
actions.expected_behavior: Creates local automation metadata draft only after confirmation.

test.expected_result: Planner maps create automation/billing workflow language to create_automation without external writes.

actions.label: Capture raw intake
actions.expected_behavior: Helper preserves raw natural-language input, parses it into canonical lanes, returns raw ID/counts, and does not echo private raw text.

test.expected_result: Planner maps ramble/goal-mode language to capture_raw_intake and parser returns raw ID/counts.

actions.label: Request watchdog audit
actions.expected_behavior: Helper creates a Codex-owned local-safe watchdog audit task without external writes.

test.expected_result: Planner maps watchdog audit language to run_watchdog_audit.

actions.label: Start a classroom draft
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a first-party provider classroom/community setup draft only.

test.expected_result: No Google Classroom, payment, send, or access grant is performed.

actions.label: Join the Shir
actions.expected_behavior: Scrolls the public visitor to the OneTime interest form; does not create checkout, send messages, or grant access.

test.expected_result: Primary CTA points to #interest and no payment action fires.

actions.label: Save join interest
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a first-party OneTime interest lead for review only; no checkout, external send, or access grant.

test.expected_result: Posts only to /api/one-time/interest and returns a no-checkout/no-send confirmation.

actions.label: Member Login
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the member login entry shell without exposing private library data to logged-out visitors.

test.expected_result: /rabbi-member or member entry shows safe login shell unless valid scoped member access is present.

actions.label: Prepare Agent Run
actions.selector_hint: button:contains('Prepare Run'), task agent verification form
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or reuses a scoped bna_agent_runs record, stores the prompt, marks the task verification state ready, and records task/run events.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/tasks/:taskId/agent-runs is Super Admin only and the Operations UI exposes the action only inside the Agents surface/task drawer.

actions.label: Copy Agent Prompt / Open ChatGPT Agent
actions.selector_hint: Copy Agent Prompt, Open ChatGPT Agent
actions.expected_behavior: Copies the scoped prompt locally or opens ChatGPT without production writes, and records a passive copied/opened event on the agent run.

test.expected_result: Progress endpoint treats copied/opened as passive audit events and does not transition the run to running.

actions.label: Post Progress / Attach Evidence
actions.expected_behavior: Records scoped progress and evidence artifacts on the assigned agent run with redaction status; it does not send, publish, delete, charge, or deploy.

test.expected_result: Progress/artifact routes require Super Admin scope and append run events/artifacts.

actions.label: Submit Result / Seal Run
actions.expected_behavior: Requires every criterion to be marked and browser/mixed evidence unless exempt; pass only closes the task when implementation is complete and automated gates passed.

test.expected_result: validateSealPayload enforces summary, criteria, and evidence; task close is gated by implementation_status and automated_gates_passed.

actions.label: Block / Resume / Reopen / Cancel Agent Run
actions.selector_hint: Mark Blocked, Resume, Reopen Fresh Run, Cancel Stale Run
actions.expected_behavior: Moves the run through allowed lifecycle transitions, creates a linked operator decision when blocked, and never mutates production data.

test.expected_result: Lifecycle routes require Super Admin scope, allowed transitions, and append audit events.

actions.label: One Time Agent Status
actions.selector_hint: [data-scoped-agent-status] Refresh, Codex Queue, Open Tasks, Open Task
actions.expected_behavior: Shows scoped One Time machine-work status, queue heartbeat, blockers, and task links for project owner/admin users without exposing Super Admin claim, submit, seal, or production mutation controls.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-operations-ui-smoke.test.js renders [data-scoped-agent-status], verifies One Time tasks, and confirms Claim/Seal controls are absent for scoped users.

actions.label: Preview Drive Brief
actions.expected_behavior: Runs a no-write preview of the latest Rabbi Elie / One Time Drive brief, proves One Time-only scope, displays owner/admin assignments, and lists credential or owner-only blockers.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/project-meetings/one-time-drive-brief/preview returns dry_run=true and Operations exposes only the preview action, not production mutation.

actions.label: Platform Suite
actions.selector_hint: ops sidebar/module toolbar Platform Suite navigation
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the mounted Platform UI suite with scoped BNA or One Time fixture data and no external writes.

test.expected_result: Operations platform_suite view mounts [data-platform-ui-root] across desktop and mobile viewports without exposing secret values or live provider mutation controls.
